Palestine Embassy Questions 'Liberation of Haifa' Narrative

The Embassy of Palestine in India has questioned a narrative describing the Battle of Haifa as an act of "liberation." The embassy has called for historical scrutiny of this narrative. The Wire reported on this, framing it as a potential rewriting of India-Palestine history and posing whether the battle was an act of liberation or occupation.
